processPage.lede: Four measured phases. One file, one coordinator, one escalation path. The protocol is the same for a four-day stay as for a three-month refit — only the volume differs.

phases.title: Intake.
phases.lede: You arrive. We listen. No form-gated discovery — a voice call with a coordinator who will remain on your file.
phases.detail: Most relationships begin as a captain forwarding our number. The intake is unhurried: your itinerary, your guest profile, what you are expecting from Montenegro, and where the last port fell short. We don't circulate notes — one coordinator holds your file.

phases.title: Brief.
phases.lede: A written service brief, scoped to your stay. Itemised, SLA-anchored, no retainer padding.
phases.detail: We return a brief that reads like a flight plan: berths proposed, customs approach, provisioning calendar, laundry cadence, standing maintenance, and an operational budget. Each line is signed by the discipline lead who will execute it.

phases.title: Operate.
phases.lede: Your coordinator becomes your desk. One number, one email, one person who owns every outcome.
phases.detail: From the moment the yacht enters territorial waters, the file is active. Your coordinator is physically in Tivat, moves between marinas as needed, and is on-call for the duration. Escalation ladders are defined; no request sits in an inbox.

phases.title: Report.
phases.lede: A post-call operational report, returned to the owner or manager. Lessons captured for next season.
phases.detail: Every visit is closed with a written report: what was requested, what was delivered, what exceeded or fell short. Your file compounds — by the third season, we have met more of your crew than most of their own colleagues have.

principles.b: Every request routes through your coordinator. Never a switchboard.
Government fees, berthing, technician labour — passed through at invoice.
We operate inside the rhythm of the yacht, not across it.
Every action logged, every parts ledger captured, every report filed.
Your stay lives in an encrypted record. Nothing leaves.

aboutPage.lede: Yacht Concierge is a dedicated shore-side desk for superyachts on the Adriatic, built on years of hands-on experience in Montenegrin waters. One team, one file, for your vessel.
aboutPage.story1: Yacht Concierge is built on years of hands-on experience in Montenegrin waters. Long before this desk carried its name, our team was already on the docks — working alongside port captains, customs offices, provisioning suppliers, and the crews who return season after season. Those relationships are the real difference, and they cannot be improvised.
aboutPage.story2: This is the natural next step in our expansion. Superyacht captains needed someone on the dock who understood the water they came from — not just the regulations of the port they had arrived at. So we created a dedicated operations desk, staffed by people who have worked both sides of the gangway.
aboutPage.story3: Today we coordinate berth reservations, customs and immigration clearance, provisioning, crew logistics, laundry, floristry, and maintenance — for vessels of every size, up and down the Montenegrin coast.
aboutPage.quote: "We built the kind of service we wanted when we were on the water ourselves — direct, accountable, and with no surprises in the invoice."
aboutPage.teamSub: Two leads. One file. Every request answered by someone with the authority to resolve it.
aboutPage.teamBio_zoran: A charter captain for years before coming ashore, Zoran built Yacht Concierge to close the shore-side gaps he kept encountering — paperwork, provisioning, and the absence of anyone who stayed on a problem until it was resolved.
aboutPage.teamBio_iva: Manages real-time logistics across all active vessel files. Former charter coordinator with direct experience in Montenegrin port authority and customs workflows. When the marina office opens at 07:00, Iva is already there.
aboutPage.accountability_text: One coordinator owns your file, start to finish. No handoffs, no gaps in the chain.
aboutPage.transparency_text: Itemised invoicing, rate-card pricing. You know the cost before we move.
aboutPage.presence_text: We are physically in Tivat. When you need someone at the marina, they are already there.

berth.coverage: Porto Montenegro · Herceg Novi · Kotor · Budva · Bar
berth.rateNote: Berth costs billed at marina list rate, no mark-up. Service fee per night, LOA-dependent.

protocol.body: Captain or manager provides ETA, LOA, beam, draft, call sign, flag state, intended stay length.
Coordinator confirms slot across our marina network based on current availability and historical berth preferences.
Slot secured, confirmation issued with berth number, hook-up particulars, and arrival coordinates.
Shore team present at berth on ETA. Lines, power, water, provisioning staging all handled.

faq.q: How quickly can you confirm a berth reservation?
faq.a: Priority confirmation is typically issued the same day the request is submitted. Our coordinator matches available slots across the marina network and issues a hold with berth number, hook-up particulars, and arrival coordinates.

faq.q: Which marinas do you cover for berth reservations?
faq.a: Porto Montenegro, Herceg Novi, Kotor, Budva, and Bar.

faq.q: How is berth pricing structured?
faq.a: Berth costs are billed at the marina's own list rate, with no mark-up. A separate service fee applies per night, based on the vessel's LOA (length overall).

faq.q: What information do you need to request a berth?
faq.a: ETA, LOA, beam, draft, call sign, flag state, and intended length of stay — submitted by the captain or manager.

faq.q: What's included once a berth is confirmed?
faq.a: Priority slot allocation, concessioned seasonal holds, shore-power and freshwater hook-up, and a security liaison — with our shore team present at the berth on ETA to handle lines, power, water, and provisioning staging.

customs.coverage: Montenegrin Ministry of Interior · Schengen adjacency
customs.rateNote: Government fees at invoice. Service fee fixed per clearance event.

protocol.body: 48 hours pre-arrival, documentation is pre-submitted to Port Authority and Customs. Any flags raised are resolved before the yacht is within territorial waters.
Licensed clearing agent boards on arrival, typically anchored off the quay. Papers reviewed, stamps issued.
TIP issued, crew list endorsed, stores manifest filed. Captain receives originals and digital copies.
Agent on-call for the duration of stay. Crew changes, stores replenishment, flag changes handled without re-intake.

faq.q: How long does customs and immigration clearance take?
faq.a: Documentation is pre-filed with Port Authority and Customs 48 hours before arrival, so any issues are resolved before the yacht reaches territorial waters — clearance on arrival is designed for a minimal wait.

faq.q: Who handles the paperwork when the yacht arrives?
faq.a: A licensed clearing agent boards the vessel on arrival, typically at anchor off the quay, reviews papers, and issues stamps directly — no handoffs between agents.

faq.q: What documents are issued during clearance?
faq.a: A Temporary Import Permit (TIP), an endorsed crew list, and a filed provisions manifest. The captain receives both originals and digital copies.

faq.q: What happens if there's a crew change or restocking during the stay?
faq.a: The clearing agent stays on-call for the duration of the stay, handling crew changes, stores replenishment, and flag changes without requiring a full re-intake.

faq.q: How are customs fees charged?
faq.a: Government fees are passed through at invoice with no mark-up; the service itself carries a fixed fee per clearance event.

fuel.coverage: Porto Montenegro · Portonovi · Bar · Budva · Kotor
fuel.sla: 24-hour standard notice; same-day where slot, vessel size, and dock availability allow
fuel.rateNote: Diesel bunkered duty-free where eligible; petrol and standard-rate fuel at pump price — fully receipted. Coordination fee is a flat percentage of the invoice.

protocol.body: Captain or purser submits fuel type (diesel, petrol, or both), estimated quantity, and charter status via encrypted portal.

Coordinator confirms duty-free diesel at Porto Montenegro, Portonovi, or Bar; standard-rate pumps at Budva and Kotor suit smaller yachts. Luštica Bay is routed to the nearest duty-free dock. Standard window is 24 hours, often same day.

Fuel delivered berth-side at the marina's own dock, or dockside at the local pump for smaller vessels. Duty-free documentation for eligible diesel prepared and filed by our licensed agent before transfer.
Delivery ticket and duty-free paperwork issued with the invoice; coordination fee applied as a flat percentage.

faq.q: How much notice do you need for bunkering?
faq.a: Standard notice is 24 hours; same-day bunkering is often possible depending on slot, vessel size, and dock availability.

faq.q: Where can I get duty-free diesel?
faq.a: Duty-free diesel bunkering is available at Porto Montenegro, Portonovi, and Bar. Vessels at Luštica Bay are routed to the nearest duty-free dock.

faq.q: What about petrol, or vessels that don't qualify for duty-free?
faq.a: Petrol and standard-rate fuel are coordinated at Budva and Kotor, suited to smaller yachts, priced at pump rate and fully receipted.

faq.q: How is the fuel delivered?
faq.a: Delivered berth-side at the marina's own dock for larger vessels, or dockside at the local pump for smaller ones. Our licensed agent prepares and files duty-free documentation before transfer.

faq.q: How is the coordination fee charged?
faq.a: As a flat percentage of the fuel invoice, itemized alongside the delivery ticket and any duty-free paperwork.

provisioning.coverage: Porto Montenegro · Herceg Novi · Kotor · Budva · Bar
provisioning.sla: Same-day for locally sourced items; imports on a short lead time
provisioning.rateNote: Produce at market rate, fully receipted. Coordination fee is a flat percentage of the invoice.

protocol.body: Chef or purser submits order via encrypted portal. Any substitution preferences noted and retained across visits.
Fresh sourced at dawn from local markets. Proteins from the Adriatic fleet. Specialty imports routed via Dubrovnik or Bari.
Cold-chain maintained from source. Provisioning staged at shore base, quality-checked by coordinator before transfer.
Berth-side handoff to galley, typically in the two-hour window before service.

faq.q: How quickly can you fulfill a provisioning order?
faq.a: Locally sourced items are typically delivered same-day; specialty imports (routed via Dubrovnik or Bari) are fulfilled on a short lead time.

faq.q: Where does the produce come from?
faq.a: Fresh items are sourced each morning from the Tivat, Kotor, and Budva markets, proteins from the Adriatic fishing fleet, and specialty items imported from Europe when needed.

faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: The chef or purser submits the list through our encrypted portal; substitution preferences are noted and retained for future visits.

faq.q: Is the cold chain maintained?
faq.a: Yes — provisioning is cold-chain maintained from source, staged and quality-checked by the coordinator at our shore base before berth-side handoff, typically within the two-hour window before service.

faq.q: Can I see prices before ordering?
faq.a: Yes — request our current price catalogues (meat, seafood, dairy, bakery, pantry, specialty, and frozen lines) for advance planning; we send the price lists and deliver to your berth.

laundry.coverage: Porto Montenegro · Herceg Novi · Kotor · Budva · Bar
laundry.rateNote: Billed per kg for linen, per item for uniforms and pressing. Volume tiers for stays over seven nights.

protocol.body: Berth-side collection with barcoded bags, logged against your vessel record.
Handled at marine-certified facility. Water hardness and detergent matched to your spec if given.
Each bag hand-inspected on return. Any replacement items sourced before delivery.
Returned folded or hanging to your preference, with a reconciliation slip against the original manifest.

faq.q: How long does laundry take?
faq.a: Standard items are returned next-day. Collection is berth-side with barcoded bags, logged against your vessel record.

faq.q: What items do you handle?
faq.a: Guest linen and towelling, crew uniforms, deck towelling, plus dry cleaning and pressing.

faq.q: Where is the laundry processed?
faq.a: At marine-certified facilities in Tivat and Budva; water hardness and detergent can be matched to your specification if provided.

faq.q: How is quality checked before return?
faq.a: Each bag is hand-inspected on return, with any replacement items sourced before delivery, and a reconciliation slip issued against the original manifest.

faq.q: How is laundry billed?
faq.a: Per kilogram for linen, per item for uniforms and pressing, with volume tiers available for stays over seven nights.

floristry.sla: Arrangements in place for charter-start day
floristry.rateNote: Priced per arrangement, with tier pricing for full-vessel specifications.

protocol.body: Tone, palette, and any charter-specific notes. We retain preferences between visits.
Fresh cut from local growers on the morning of installation, or flown in for out-of-season requests.
On-board installation by our florist, using vessel-owned vases or ours. Discreet, usually within two hours.
Mid-stay refresh or full redo scheduled in advance, executed during a scheduled off-vessel window.

faq.q: When will the flowers be ready?
faq.a: Arrangements are timed to be in place for charter-start day.

faq.q: Where do the flowers come from?
faq.a: Fresh cut from local Tivat growers on the morning of installation, following the seasonal bloom calendar; out-of-season or specific requests can be flown in on a 72-hour lead time.

faq.q: Can you match a specific style or color palette?
faq.a: Yes — we take a brief on tone, palette, and any charter-specific notes, and retain preferences between visits.

faq.q: Do you refresh arrangements during a charter?
faq.a: Yes — a mid-stay refresh or full redo can be scheduled in advance and is executed during a scheduled off-vessel window.

faq.q: How is floristry priced?
faq.a: Per arrangement, with tier pricing available for full-vessel specifications.

maintenance.coverage: Electrical, hydraulics, refrigeration, A/V, hull wash, tender service
maintenance.sla: Vetted technician dispatched to the berth on request
maintenance.rateNote: Labour at technician rate, full pass-through with ledger. Coordination fee per dispatch.

protocol.body: Engineer or captain describes the fault. Where possible, a diagnostic is run on our in-house systems before dispatch.
The right specialist, not the nearest. We maintain a vetted network of technicians across the Montenegrin coast.
Our coordinator is present for the visit. Notes are kept, parts reconciled, warranty captured.
Work report filed to the vessel log, with photographs and a parts ledger. Nothing left undocumented.

faq.q: How fast can a technician reach my yacht?
faq.a: A vetted technician is dispatched to the berth on request; where possible, a diagnostic is run on our in-house systems before dispatch, so the right specialist is sent first time.

faq.q: What kind of work do you coordinate?
faq.a: Electrical, hydraulic, refrigeration, and A/V systems, hull washing, and tender service.

faq.q: Is someone present during the repair?
faq.a: Yes — our coordinator is present for the visit, keeping notes, reconciling parts, and capturing warranty information.

faq.q: How is the work documented?
faq.a: Every job is filed to the vessel log with photographs and a parts ledger, so nothing is left undocumented.

faq.q: How is maintenance billed?
faq.a: Labour is billed at the technician's rate, fully passed through with a ledger, plus a coordination fee per dispatch.
